blocks.text: Alkenes unsaturated hydrocarbons hain aur zyada tar electrophilic addition reactions karte hain. Kuch aur chhoti qisam ki reactions bhi hoti hain: oxidation, combustion (jalna) aur polymerization (chhote molecules ka jur kar lambi chain banana).

blocks.prompt: Addition aur elimination reaction mein farq batayein, aur addition se molecule zyada saturated kyun ho jata hai (Quick Check 11.7b, 11.9ii; exercise Q.2d)?
blocks.explanation: Addition mein chhota molecule double bond par jurta hai; double bond khul kar do single bonds ban jate hain. Product mein carbons se zyada atoms jure hote hain aur koi multiple bond nahi rehta, is liye woh zyada saturated hai. Elimination is ka ulat hai: saath wale carbons se pani ya HBr jaisa chhota molecule nikal kar double bond banta hai. Ethanol ki dehydration se ethene banti hai; ethene ki hydration se ethanol wapas banta hai.

items: Alkenes zyada tar electrophilic addition karte hain; oxidation, combustion aur polymerization bhi.
